notes.random: Each is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday ES–RTY spread trades on random days and times, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades, the same share of long-spread trades and the same month's hedge ratio, paying the same costs on both legs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. These were picked from the EMRT finalists using their 2023–2024 results (one of them despite failing the 40-trade validation minimum), so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice. The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: First EMRT look at the ES-RTY holdout. No pair strategy had been scored on 2025 onward before (apart from the final-test of these same frozen picks), and only these, frozen beforehand, were run, so there's no selection among holdout results. But single-market strategies were already scored on ES 2025+ (and RTY for some families), and the two picks were chosen after seeing validation. Chosen by the user on 2026-11-19 after reading the validation results: #2 (1:1 hedge, formation z, exit at mean) and #10 (OLS hedge, time-of-day 60-session z). #2 FAILED validation on trade count only (37 < 40 completed trades; net +1.8%, Sharpe 0.68) and is included by the user's explicit choice, overriding that gate; #10 passed validation (Sharpe 0.40). #1 and #6 were set aside as near-duplicates of #2 (daily-return correlation 0.92-0.95). Picked after seeing validation, so the holdout is not a blind test of the funnel's output.
